description: This file contains unit tests for retry logic within a storage package, specifically testing the behavior of retrying database operations with various error conditions, context cancellations, and exponential backoff strategies.

methods.name: TestRetryDatabaseOperation_Success
methods.description: Tests successful retry of a database operation that completes on first attempt.

methods.name: TestRetryDatabaseOperation_RetryableError
methods.description: Tests retry logic when a transient retryable error occurs initially.

methods.name: TestRetryDatabaseOperation_NonRetryableError
methods.description: Ensures that non-retryable errors abort the retry process immediately.

methods.name: TestRetryDatabaseOperation_MaxRetriesExceeded
methods.description: Checks that retry attempts cease after reaching the maximum retries.

methods.name: TestRetryDatabaseOperation_ContextCancellation
methods.description: Verifies that context cancellation during operation halts retries and propagates the cancellation.

methods.name: TestRetryDatabaseOperation_ContextCancellationDuringDelay
methods.description: Tests cancellation during exponential backoff delay.

methods.name: TestIsRetryableError
methods.description: Tests the detection of various errors as retryable based on message content.

methods.name: TestRetryOnConstraintFailure_Success
methods.description: Tests successful retries on transient constraint failures.

methods.name: TestRetryOnConstraintFailure_TransientError
methods.description: Tests retry logic on transient constraint errors such as 'database is locked'.

methods.name: TestRetryOnConstraintFailure_ValidationError
methods.description: Ensures validation errors do not trigger retries.

methods.name: TestRetryOnConstraintFailure_ForeignKeyError
methods.description: Tests retry behavior with foreign key constraint errors.

methods.name: TestRetryOnConstraintFailure_DuplicateDIDError
methods.description: Tests retry logic with duplicate DID errors.

methods.name: TestRetryOnConstraintFailure_MaxRetries
methods.description: Checks that retries do not exceed maximum count for constraint failures.

methods.name: TestRetryOnConstraintFailure_ContextCancellation
methods.description: Verifies retries abort on context cancellation during constraint failure retries.

methods.name: TestRetryOnConstraintFailure_ExponentialBackoff
methods.description: Verifies exponential backoff timing during retry attempts.

methods.name: TestIsRetryableError_CaseInsensitive
methods.description: Tests detection of retryable errors with different case variants.

methods.name: TestRetryDatabaseOperation_ExponentialBackoff
methods.description: Checks timing and retry behavior with exponential backoff.

methods.name: TestRetryDatabaseOperation_ErrorMessages
methods.description: Verifies that various SQLite error messages are correctly identified as retryable.
